title: Featured recognition quotes
description: Which papers' recognition of SQLancer is quoted on the impact page. An editorial judgement about which claims stand on their own, not something derivable from the records, so it is written down with a reason.

paper_id.description: Must be a paper whose describes_as_state_of_the_art is yes.

mention_id.description: Which of that relationship's quoted sentences to show. The sentence itself is never copied here: it is read from the paper's record, so a highlight cannot drift from its source.
